hearthford.name: The Silt-Chancel
hearthford.theme: flooded measures and forgotten grain vows

boss.name: the Silt Abbot
boss.capability: drains a flooded lane before pressing with a spear
boss.counterplay: keep the water between you or deny the drain

greywash.name: The Salt Reliquary
greywash.theme: wreck titles and salt-caked oath tablets

boss.name: the Chain Prelate
boss.capability: signals a roof escort before firing across an open lane
boss.counterplay: split the escort from its signal or use the chamber walls

boss.name: the Ash Cantor
boss.capability: kindles finite roof fuel while circling the stalls
boss.counterplay: wet the fuel or leave the warned lane

boss.name: the Bell Warden
boss.capability: marks a weakened roof support and denies the stair with a net
boss.counterplay: brace the support or move through the second doorway

dunmire.name: The Peat Lantern
dunmire.theme: raised refuge and drowned fuel claims

boss.name: the Fen Lantern
boss.capability: drains its own flooded gallery before firing
boss.counterplay: use wet cover or interrupt the drainage

rillscar.name: The Two-Span Ossuary
rillscar.theme: bridge tolls and unburied quarry debt

boss.name: the Span Collector
boss.capability: braces a failing crossing while sheltering its guard
boss.counterplay: separate the guard or take the alternate span

marlbank.name: The Kiln Testament
marlbank.theme: seed water and fired clay promises

boss.name: the Kiln Adjudicator
boss.capability: lights finite kiln fuel before closing the aisle
boss.counterplay: quench the fuel or cross behind the partition

frostmere.name: The Ice-Sound Chapel
frostmere.theme: winter soundings and false channel lights

boss.name: the Soundless Pilot
boss.capability: spends finite dressings on a roof escort while sighting the channel
boss.counterplay: isolate the escort or force a close doorway fight
